scripts.dev: node scripts/dev-db.mjs && concurrently --kill-others -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/domain && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
